entry.title: Strong Wind Watch
entry.summary: North to northwest winds may approach severe gale in exposed places. Winds easing from the south during Friday afternoon and evening. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 70 to 90 mm of rain about the ranges. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Heavy rain in the south of the broader area has eased. However, another burst of heavy rain is expected during Friday morning and a Warning has been issued to cover this period.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 140 to 180 mm of rain about the main divide, and 100 to 140 mm within 20 km farther east, possibly more in localised areas. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected Friday morning about the divide. Freezing level 2200 metres. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal. Changes: Onset time of Warning brought forward to 3 pm.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 100 to 150 mm of rain about the main divide, and 70 to 100 mm within 20 km farther east, possibly more in localised areas. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h expected this afternoon and evening about the divide. Freezing level 1500 metres rising to 2200 metres this evening. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: In addition to what has already fallen, expect 140 to 180 mm of rain about the ranges, and 70 to 100 mm nearer the coast, possibly more in localised areas. Peak rates of 20 to 30 mm/h expected from this afternoon about the ranges. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Low.

entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow above 800 metres, where snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria. Note, lesser amounts of snow could fall as low as 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Low. End time of Watch brought forward to 3 pm.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow falling to around 500 metres. Expect a further 5-10 cm to accumulate about the summit, mainly falling this morning, with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Further snowfall is likely until late afternoon or early evening. 5 to 10 cm could settle about Homer Tunnel with lesser amounts to 700 metres.
